properties.description:
SMWMFL

The National Weather Service in Miami has issued a

* Special Marine Warning for...
Biscayne Bay...
Coastal waters from Deerfield Beach to Ocean Reef FL out 20 NM...
Waters from Deerfield Beach to Ocean Reef FL from 20 to 60 NM
excluding the territorial waters of Bahamas...

* Until 130 PM EST.

* At 1202 PM EST, severe thunderstorms capable of producing
waterspouts were located along a line extending from Virginia Key
to Card Sound, moving northwest at 5 knots.

HAZARD...Waterspouts and wind gusts to nearly 50 knots.

SOURCE...Radar.

IMPACT...Waterspouts can easily overturn boats and create locally
hazardous seas. Small craft could be damaged in briefly
higher winds and suddenly higher waves.

Sunny Isles, Convoy Point, Turkey Point, Card Sound, Key Biscayne,
Biscayne Bay, Pacific Reef, Black Point, Cape Florida, Virginia
Key, Bay Harbor Islands, Soldier Key, Miami Beach, Elliott Key, Bal
Harbour, Golden Beach, Triumph Reef, Surfside, Indian Creek, and
North Bay Village.
properties.instruction:

Report severe weather to the Coast Guard or the National Weather
Service. You can also share your report with NWS Miami on Facebook
and Twitter.

St Johns River Near Astor affecting Lake and Volusia Counties.

flow causing a surge up the river as well as additional heavy
rainfall expected in the Astor area.

forecast.

forecast.
